thread.label: Exodus 13:3-11
thread.text: And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the Lord brought you out from this place: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.

classes.title: Leaven: The Root of Bitterness

precepts.label: Numbers 14:27-34
precepts.why:
Exodus 13:8 says “And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which the Lord did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.” This is done means the feast of unleavened bread. But what did the Lord do unto me? The Lord delivered everyone, but did everyone enter the promised land? No. Numbers 14 shows what he did.

“How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me?” When we came out of Egypt, our people were evil. You thought they were righteous? They were rebellious: a bunch of liars, fornicators, murmurers. The Lord said, “as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward”. Once you were twenty years old and up, the Lord said, all of you are going to die. Aaron died. Moses died too; not that Moses was evil, but the people provoked him to anger, so he did not see the promised land, though when he left his body he was going back to paradise.

“Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.” Joshua and Caleb were the only two adults the Lord allowed to make it in. According to the law, at twenty you are the age of a man and take responsibility for yourself, which is why twenty is the age to marry. Everybody twenty and up, their blood was on their own head.

“But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.” The children wandered forty years and bore the whoredoms of the adults, seeing all the evil they did, “until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness”: until every last one of those wicked Israelites died, everybody who had leaven in them, the murmurers, the adulterers, the ones who held on to Egypt.

So the me of Exodus 13:8 is not Moses. It is the little ones, twenty years and under, who grew up in the land and told their sons: we keep unleavened bread because the Lord purged the leaven out of me in the wilderness. And it is the same in the future: whoever keeps leaven, which is sin, through the seven days, that soul shall be cut off.

thread.label: Exodus 20:17
thread.text: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour’s.

classes.title: The Vantage Point of the Elders: the Fathers Have Spoken

precepts.label: 2 Peter 1:4-5
precepts.why:
To covet is not simply to desire. It is to want what belongs to another inordinately: you violate God's laws to get it. “Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour’s”. The daughter belongs under the father just like everything else in his house. Go around him to get her, never telling the fathers or the elders, and you have coveted. To entice is to allure, to bait, to induce to evil; it is trickery and deception. “My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not”. And “Love worketh no ill to his neighbour”: if you love the sister, how did you use ill means to get her?

Peter shows what we are supposed to be doing instead: “Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust. And beside this, giving all diligence”.

As brothers and sisters come in here, you are supposed to be escaping these worldly elements and truly repenting. When you look across the aisle, you are supposed to be looking for righteousness, not just her behind. Taking your sister for lust is the corruption that is in the world, and the same thing goes on on the other side. A man who talks to you under cover, without your father and without the leadership, does not have good intentions; the fact that he didn't do it the right way shows you where his mind is.

Do it with diligence, the right way. When we announce our marriages we say, this is the day the Lord has made between you two; you can bring forth righteousness right here, and the Lord, the angels and everybody are in agreement with it. When you do things the right way, you have a whole community behind you. The fathers and the elders have the vantage point: we see down the road where it is going, and we make the decision as fathers.

thread.label: Exodus 22:1,16-17
thread.text: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

classes.title: The Vantage Point of the Elders: the Fathers Have Spoken

precepts.label: Leviticus 6:4-5
precepts.why:
Exodus 22:17: “If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins”. He has to pay, but he still is not getting the daughter. Somebody might say, he paid, so he gets to take her. Leviticus 6 shows the principle: “Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away”.

Took violently away. To entice that daughter against her father's wishes is to violate him, and violation is violence. That is the same reason a man who steals an ox must “restore five oxen for an ox”: the owner was violated, and restitution is paid for the violent act against him.

“or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten”. The recent matter was deceit. Her fathers didn't know anything about it, the leadership didn't know anything about it, nobody knew until her sister discovered it, and they still weren't going to say anything. How are you going to come up later saying, here's the law?

“Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering”. The principal is the actual thing taken, and the fifth part is added on top. So you are not getting the daughter, and you still have to pay the fathers. That is why the judgment goes forward: we will not leave that kind of example for the rest of the sisters, to be beguiled by a wicked brother who says we're applying Exodus 22:16. That's a damn lie.

precepts.label: Matthew 19:3-8
precepts.why:
The Pharisees came to Christ “tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?” They were trying to use Moses' law, the writing of divorcement in Deuteronomy 24. Christ took them back to the beginning: “Have ye not read, that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female, And said, For this cause shall a man leave father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife: and they twain shall be one flesh?” From the beginning there was no such thing as divorce. What are you talking about, quoting Moses? It's the same as a negro trying to quote Exodus 22:16.

“Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder”. God did not put these backdoor marriages together. That's why love worketh no ill to his neighbour: you will not do evil and call yourself love. You don't love anything but your own lust.

“Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement, and to put her away? He saith unto them, Moses because of the hardness of your hearts suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it was not so”. The only reason Moses had to bring in that negro-proof law is that we were hard-headed and gave Moses hell. It is a failsafe law, a kind of bylaw to keep us from going all the way wicked. You are not supposed to be in failure at all for it even to come up, and quoting one after you went off and did wrong does not make you righteous.

That is covering violence with the garment: “for one covereth violence with his garment, saith the Lord of hosts: therefore take heed to your spirit, that ye deal not treacherously”. The Pharisees enlarged the borders of their garments, and the fringes represent the laws. A man who deceived to get a sister and then gives her a so-called law from the Bible is covering his violation with the law. Sisters and brothers, watch yourselves, hold yourselves in the diligence of the scriptures, and stop playing games.

precepts.label: 1 Corinthians 10:5-8
precepts.why:
At the golden calf “the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.” What was that rose up to play? You think it was hopscotch? Paul explains it.

“Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.” He is quoting the very verse, and before it he says: “Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.” When they lusted after evil things, that is the rose up to play.

The verse before that: “But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.” Why were they overthrown in the wilderness? Because they lusted after evil things.

Then verse 8: “Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.” So we understand the rose up to play was fornication. They lusted after evil things, and it destroyed us.

The nations understood this. When we are in sin, they know what will happen, they can destroy us. So when they took their crafty counsel they said, how do we keep these people in error? They like to rap, so give them murder music and lascivious music. That is why they give our sisters these songs, so vulgar. Their whole plan is to keep us in sin. Pleasure now, regret later: you are going to pay.

precepts.label: Hosea 4:1-2
precepts.why:
Leviticus warns that if a daughter is prostituted, “the land become full of wickedness.” Hosea shows what full of wickedness looks like: “Hear the word of the Lord, ye children of Israel: for the Lord hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.” Controversy means against: the Lord is against how we live. It speaks mainly of the northern kingdom, but all of us are doing this now.

No truth: “Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.” Truth is the Bible, the laws. Nobody in the land is adhering to “Do not prostitute thy daughter”; nobody is paying attention to it or bringing that precaution into the land. No mercy: people get killed over this. Brothers have gone to jail and been shot down over it. No knowledge of God, meaning his commandments: the priest's lips should keep knowledge and the people should seek the law at his mouth, and they are not getting it at all.

“By swearing, and lying”. We heard complete lies two weeks ago: a man told everybody that nobody had told him to leave the sister alone, to make it look as if the leadership didn't know what was going on. Brothers had to stand up, bring him right back to his lying statement, and correct his wicked ass in front of everybody, so nobody would think he had a toe to stand on to justify the evil he did. Then: “and killing, and stealing”: we saw that in the videos.

All of it because the woman was taught to let her behind hang out. The Bible gives a dress code: cover your ass. The Lord gave a dress code because he knows that when the clothes come off, all kinds of things go on. David saw Bathsheba, and he lost it all. Then: “and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood”. People get stabbed and shot up, all because she had her clothes off in the street. Do you see the connection?

So “full of wickedness” means literally full of wickedness: that is what you get when God's laws are not taught, no Bible, no scruples, no laws. Having kids through backdoor marriages produces madness like this. That is done here. You're going to do it right or you ain't going to do it at all; nobody is holding a ceremony over fornication. It starts with the fathers and mothers, who must not prostitute the daughter, because the enemy goes after the women: mess them up and the children are done.

precepts.label: Numbers 25:18
precepts.why:
“the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.” “And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.” What would cause us to bow down to their gods? It just says they committed whoredom. It was sex that got the people to worship another god, and “Israel joined himself unto Baal–peor: and the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel.”

Jump to the end of the chapter: “For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor”. They vex you with their wiles, their seduction, and beguiled you into worshipping their gods. They knew: we have to get these people to sin against their God. So they used this tricknology, this stratagem, to move them away from God. That was the popular plan. “and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor’s sake.”

“For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world”. It was Moab then, and it is all the nations now. Today the majority of the pornography is controlled by Amalek and Edom. They understood: we are going to destroy the minds of the people. We are not the only race having sex, but all our music is derogatory and evil, every video is a twerk video, and even somebody’s grandmother is twerking online. Everything is over-sexualized to destroy the minds of our young people, along with the drugs, the whoring and the music.

These are the wiles of the devil. The Lord would not let Balaam curse Israel, so the counsel was to make Israel fall through whoredom. As long as we continue in whoredom we will not build healthy marriages, we will not produce spiritually healthy children, and the generational curses keep going. Our strength is to come back to the laws of God.

thread.text: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king’s house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.

classes.title: Satan's Kiss To Your Demise

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 47:1
precepts.why:
“And after him rose up Nathan to prophesy in the time of David.” So we know who we are talking about: this is David, in the days of Nathan the prophet, the prophet the Lord sent to him after Bathsheba. The next verse carries on: “As is the fat taken away from the peace offering, so was David chosen out of the children of Israel.”

That is the same David of 2 Samuel 11. He went out on the roof, “he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.” Bad to the bone. He sent and inquired: I got power, let me send some people over there, let me make this official. One with a spiritual mind made it plain: this is the wife of Uriah the Hittite, this is somebody's wife, bro. “And David sent messengers, and took her” anyway. Wisdom and understanding were right there, and he pushed them aside.

“and she came in unto him, and he lay with her”. She wasn't right either. She didn't resist, she wasn't opposed; she thought she came up. “And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I am with child.”

You see how Satan can deceive you. Satan put that lust in him to where he just didn't care, and he went the extra mile: he put Uriah in the front of the battle, got him killed, and took the wife. What he saw, the desire, the action, the cover-up, and the consequences: his first child was gone. Yet Sirach remembers David as the one chosen out of the children of Israel, and that leads to what the Lord did with him.

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 47:11
precepts.why:
“The Lord took away his sins, and exalted his horn for ever: he gave him a covenant of kings, and a throne of glory in Israel.” The Lord did forgive David. He loved David, and David messed up.

David saw Bathsheba from the roof, took another man's wife, put Uriah in battle to be killed, and lost the child. That is as bad as it gets. But David repented, and the Lord took away his sins, exalted his horn, and gave him a covenant of kings and a throne of glory in Israel.

And that's another thing. A lot of times we are going to fall and do things that are not comely according to the scriptures. That don't mean you bunker down, go into a fetal position and say woe is me. You get yourself together, you repent, and you move forward. You don't go back. What did Christ say? Go, and sin no more.

You got to pick up the pieces and keep moving. We are all going to make mistakes. It is how you handle the mistake: it happened, so what are you going to do now, moving forward?

precepts.label: Psalms 51:11
precepts.why:
Solomon was knocked down, and David, the man after the Lord's own heart, was knocked down. Did they stay down? No. We are not in the business of staying down; we get knocked down and keep going. Satan tells us to stay down, and some brothers and sisters want you to stay down, but that is not what God said. “The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.” That is what God is looking for.

So what do we pray when Satan knocks us down? David prayed it: “Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.” We pray that the Lord does not remove his Holy Spirit from us, because that is what keeps us standing.

“Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me with thy free spirit.” You have to look at the truth with a joyful and glad heart, because you cannot live without it; it is part of your system, your life. Where else can you go? We do not give up our position; we pray that the Lord keeps strengthening us.

“Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.” When we get back up, our job is to teach, because we have been through the trial and tribulation and understand what it takes. We go right back to the business we left off, teaching our people their transgressions so they do not fall into what we fell into. Do we give that up to go sit on the couch, or sit in the back and puff up on evil?

Nobody sees the prayer, the crying at night, the tears when you are home alone thinking, I could have done better. That is the broken and contrite heart God will not despise. Tell Satan to bring it on. With a position or without it, be the same: a trooper. And when a brother is knocked down, do not applaud it; fast and pray for him, because he is still fighting the same battle you are, and your sin may just not be revealed as quickly as his.

precepts.label: Judith 5:11
precepts.why:
The psalm says of the nations, “They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.” Who are God's people? We are God's people. And Judith shows one of their crafty counsels from the beginning: “Therefore the king of Egypt rose up against them, and dealt subtilly with them, and brought them low with labouring in brick, and made them slaves.”

That is one of their crafty counsels: we are going to work them to death. Today many of our people are working two big jobs, living paycheck to paycheck, too poor to stop working. It is happening even more with Trump in office. There is no middle class; that thing is gone. You can't work for a living wage and survive out here.

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 10:12-13
precepts.why:
“Pride goeth before destruction”. Where does pride begin? Sirach: “The beginning of pride is when one departeth from God, and his heart is turned away from his Maker.” That means you have a froward mind.

“For pride is the beginning of sin”: the beginning of you falling to sin, falling for your temptation, falling to your lust, falling to feed that appetite. You knew better. You had all the warning signs, all the opportunity, everything placed in front of you. You were given a way out, as 1 Corinthians 10:13 said: God will with the temptation make a way to escape. But pride overcame you. Your mind wasn't on the Lord when your back was against the wall.

“and he that hath it shall pour out abomination”. When you have that pride, a negro is unstoppable; a prideful negro, oh my God. “and therefore the Lord brought upon them strange calamities, and overthrew them utterly.” When pride overtakes you, the Lord adds things to your demise: I'm going to leave you to Satan to gobble you on up, because your mind ain't right; you're too prideful.

That is why pride goes before destruction. Pride removes correction; you don't want to hear it. You think you know it all, you have all the wisdom and understanding. Pride isolates you, and it precedes the collapse.

precepts.label: Wisdom of Solomon 1:3
precepts.why:
Sirach says pride begins when one departs from God. The Wisdom of Solomon shows how a man departs: “For froward thoughts separate from God”.

Being froward means you are thinking outside of the Bible. Period. That's what it is.

When your mind is not on the Lord, you are separated from him. You can't be both. So pride starts in the thoughts: the moment your thinking goes outside of the scriptures, you have separated yourself from God, and a haughty spirit is on its way to the fall. That is why the man who meditates on the scriptures has something to pull from when temptation comes, and the froward man doesn't.

precepts.label: Ecclesiasticus 25:1-2
precepts.why:
This is how much the Lord hates pride. Sirach first shows what God loves: “In three things I was beautified, and stood up beautiful both before God and men: the unity of brethren, the love of neighbours, a man and a wife that agree together.”

The unity of brethren the Lord loves; the love of neighbors the Lord loves. And a man and wife that agree together: why is that beautiful? Because it's hard for two different personalities to come together and be on the same accord. That's why marriage takes time, brothers and sisters. It isn't overnight; it takes years and experience.

Now the negative: “Three sorts of men my soul hateth, and I am greatly offended at their life: a poor man that is proud, a rich man that is a liar, and an old adulterer that doateth.” He is offended at their life. A negro that's poor and proud: I hate that negro, I hate his soul, I hate everything about him. How can you be that way?

It means you have no humility whatsoever. Nobody can tell you anything; you have all the answers, but no fruits in your life, no solutions, no shame. That is the pride that goes before destruction, and God's soul hates it.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 16:14
precepts.why:
“For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God.” That is America going into space; America was the first there, and America invented the airplane that ascends “above the heights of the clouds.” “I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north.” That is the Monroe Doctrine, now the Donroe Doctrine. The congregation is Mexico, Central and South America, Panama, Puerto Rico, Dominica, Jamaica, Trinidad and the Caribbean islands, where the twelve tribes of Israel are. America, the king of Babylon, the oppressor, sits upon the congregation and rules over us: fall in line, or what we did to Maduro we will do to you. And it is in the sides of the north, North America; that is why its treaty with Europe is called the North Atlantic Treaty.

Jeremiah shows where Israel is: “Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that it shall no more be said, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt; But, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north.” The land of the north is North America. It is going to be said that the Lord brought the children of Israel out of this side of the world.

“and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.” Israel is in North America and all through this hemisphere, and 2 Esdras speaks of the ten tribes coming to this side of the world.

So the one who sits on the mount of the congregation in the sides of the north is sitting on Israel. According to prophecy, America will be sitting on these congregations in the last days, during the fourth seal, and bad things are about to happen on this side of the world. But the Lord will bring his people up out of the land of the north.

thread.label: Isaiah 19:1-2
thread.text: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the Lord rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.

classes.title: Eleutherophobia the Fear of Freedom

precepts.label: Revelation 11:8
precepts.why:
“The burden of Egypt.” Egypt was before Isaiah’s time, so what Egypt is this speaking about? Revelation answers it: “their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also our Lord was crucified.”

It says spiritually. Sodom is not around anymore; it is destroyed, those cities of Sodom and Gomorrah near Ein Bokek are nothing. But spiritual Sodom is here. It goes on even in the landmass of Israel among the Israelis, but prominently and predominately here in America, with all types of switcheroos: men acting like women and women acting like men, committing things contrary to the laws of God. And it is spiritual Egypt, the house of bondage. So replace Egypt with America: the burden of America.

“where also our Lord was crucified.” They crucify Christ in his image, in his message, and in denying that you men are the greatest thing on the face of this earth. They say, hell no, all people, God loves everybody.

“And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city.” America is that great city, and our people are spiritually dead here. They are fearful of freedom; there is no spirit in them to rebel with the laws of God.

So when Isaiah says the Lord rides upon a swift cloud and comes into Egypt, it is the Lord coming with his chariots and angels to bring wrath and destruction upon America. Its idols shall be moved at his presence, and its heart, the mindset, doctrines and mentality of the oppressive kingdom, shall melt in the midst of it. He will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: militia against militia, civil war, brother against brother, city against city. This place is divided; the stars are falling and the stripes are broken. That is Esau rising against himself, and it is not our fight.

thread.label: Isaiah 26:3
thread.text: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.

classes.title: Eleutherophobia the Fear of Freedom

precepts.label: Jude 1:20-21
precepts.why:
Isaiah says the Lord keeps him in perfect peace “because he trusteth in thee.” That is the key part. You trust in the Lord, you trust in his words, and you build yourself up. Jude says it: “But ye, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Ghost”.

It is the leaders' job to build the man, but once you have the foundation, it is on you to take the notes from the classes, apply them to yourself and add to them. Do a serious checkup from the neck up. Take an erasable dry marker to your mirror and write your issues with the scriptures next to them, what you need to fix, and at the top write: execute. Those are your orders for the day. If you don't see it, you're never going to fix it. Too many brothers and sisters don't write anything down: notes done, Bible closed the rest of the week, and then they're stressing, when the fix to what they were dealing with last week and what they will face this week came out in the class. We don't examine ourselves.

Don't ask the captain what he sees in you. What do you see in you? Leadership has the blessing of discernment, but that only goes so far; we can't see through you or know all the deep recesses of what you're dealing with. You have to go before the Lord, explain it, confess it, and ask him in sincerity to remove those things from you.

Don't play with what you know you are dealing with. The spirits on brothers and sisters who could care less can rub off even on leadership; a lot of brothers and sisters are spiritual vampires, and it takes a toll on leaders who love our people. God has this hospital set up for you to get the help, and the medicine is the laws. You have a headache, you don't throw the Tylenol in the trash, you take it. So why throw away the medicine when it concerns your soul and your salvation? Why be fearful of freedom?

“Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life.” Keep yourselves in the love of God, not in the crosshairs of his anger, his rage, his wrath. It is our job to keep ourselves there. I can't save you, and you can't save me. It ain't going to be easy; you have to go through this fiery trial to get the kingdom. So do your part. You have the keys to freedom, and that is the trust that keeps the mind stayed on the Lord in perfect peace.

precepts.label: Joshua 1:8
precepts.why:
What actually brings us peace? Not enlisting in this war, and not hoping America goes back to the old ways. “Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee”. The mind that is stayed on the Lord is the mindset of Joshua 1:8: the book of the law does not depart out of your mouth, and you meditate on it day and night.

That is your four chapters a day. That is you not separating yourself, and having that godly conversation consistently, as in Malachi, where they thought upon the Lord's name and a book of remembrance was written. That is making sure the sick among us in the congregations are well taken care of. That is you men doing the blitz, traveling, doing your due diligence by all manner to get out of that black shirt and get out here and teach your people, to become men of valor and soldiers of the Lord, and put in your brick.

You establish yourself on the laws of God. That is your meditation, your chief joy. You're not worried about what is played on the radio, and you could give a damn about what's on the internet unless it is funneled through the Bible so you can keep up with the times.

Then the news, the destruction and the chaos won't worry you. You'll have a Coke bottle smile from one ear to the next, because you know the mysteries. You're not fearful of freedom. The mind that meditates on the law day and night is the mind the Lord keeps in perfect peace.

Isaiah says the wilderness and the desert shall be glad and “blossom as the rose.” When we are delivered, the desert places in our land will blossom and trees will start springing up, because we are connected to the earth. When the righteous people start ruling, everything changes. The animals are free, and the creatures understand us. That may sound like church talk, but the donkey did talk to Balaam: why are you beating me? Revelation shows how far that understanding goes.

“Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honour, and glory, and blessing.” Christ receives all these things.

“And every creature which is in heaven”: those are the angels. There are creatures in heaven. “and on the earth”: the animals created on the earth. “and under the earth”: creatures created in the earth, worms and such, and creatures living deep in the earth that nobody has ever seen. “and such as are in the sea”: leviathan, and creatures in the sea no human being has ever seen, that the Lord created. “and all that are in them”: everything that was created.

“heard I saying, Blessing, and honour, and glory, and power, be unto him that sitteth upon the throne, and unto the Lamb for ever and ever.” They heard what John said, and they understood it, all the creatures.

That is why the land itself rejoices in Isaiah 35. The whole creation answers to the Lord, and when “the glory of Lebanon” is given and they “see the glory of the Lord, and the excellency of our God”, it is because the Lord will be on the earth, and everything will change.

precepts.why:
Isaiah calls Israel “a people robbed and spoiled.” We are robbed of our nationality, robbed of the understanding that we are the twelve tribes of the children of Israel. Jeremiah shows how we are spoiled, and what the Lord will do about it.

“Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured”: that is going to take place upon the oppressors of our people. “and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity”: the adversaries are all the nations outside of the children of Israel, and every one of the nations that oppress us shall go into captivity.

How do they spoil us? Over a multitude of captivities the children of Israel have gone into, every single nation has had its hand in the oppression of the twelve tribes. That includes the Arabs, that a lot of brothers and sisters want to cry over when they see what is going on in Palestine. Those people had our people oppressed too; they were spoiling the hell out of us. What we are seeing overseas right now is the righteous judgment of the Lord, prophecy fulfilling right now.

Yet brothers and sisters are so damn fearful to escape this captivity and get themselves together, even as the prophecies come to pass. Many are called, but few are chosen, so self-examine. With bombs dropping and rumors of war, men are still catting around, committing fornication, letting their wives rule over them and hide their folly, paying for prostitutes, hooked on marijuana and controlled by the porn system. Our people are sick; they are afraid of freedom, because sin controls them.

“and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.” The nations that spoiled us shall in turn be a spoil for us, because the tables are turned. precepts.label: Isaiah 47:12
precepts.why:
Babylon's destruction comes “in a moment in one day”, and the Lord gives the reason: “for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.” There was sorcery used upon our people in America, and then America used that same thing on all the nations.

That is why your uncle and your auntie won't repent after you accepted Christianity. That is witchcraft, used to keep you in the state of mind you are in. It is the pattern of every captivity: from the Assyrian captivity to the Babylonian, from the Medes and the Persians to the Greeks and to Rome, and now we are in America. All the nations have always used enchantments and witchcraft against us to keep us in darkness, and Satan is dealing with them.

The word enchantment means magic, witchcraft, sorcery, wizardry, necromancy, conjuration, hypnotism, mesmerism, voodoo, charms, spells, incantations, mojo. Remember coming out of Egypt, when the magicians were doing their things? Those magicians are who call themselves scientists today, with different titles under that name. They are the witches of this earth. Hypnotism is like the movie Get Out: our people have been sinking, and it is time to help them come out. America did not use only words against us. It used every witchcraft and every voodoo it could find, and the Catholic church is part of that foolishness.

Then the Lord dares them: “Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth.” America has been dealing with the devil from its youth up. “If so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.” The Lord is saying: since you have practiced these things from your youth, let me see if you will prevail against me. Let me see if that little nuke, that robot that is half a man, all that witchcraft and all the media you have through the earth, can stop what I am bringing into this earth.

We saw it when America was trying to attack and the Lord raised up a storm that destroyed helicopters and airplanes. They don't understand the prophecy. These things are already written, and no man can change them. The nuclear weapons every nation holds are not going to sit on a shelf like extra paint; an ICBM can reach Washington in under half an hour, and what Isaiah and Jeremiah spoke of exists in our time.

That is why we are out here teaching and telling our people to repent. We see what is coming. The same way God destroyed the first world with a flood, he is going to destroy this world with fire, and no sorcery or weapon can stop what God has written.

precepts.label: 2 Esdras 6:1-6
precepts.why:
We say give the Lord no rest, make the time short, bring it on: when is he coming to get us out? We are trying to speed the Lord up. But the Lord has his timetable and a reason for the pace he is moving at, and when it is time for him to move, you can't stop it. Esau won't be able to stop it. “Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off.” When all the planets have lined up, it is time to send Christ and the destroying angels to bring his people home, and if you are not ready, he comes as a thief in the night.

Ezra shows the mind of the Most High, his vantage point: “Before the fair flowers were seen, or ever the moveable powers were established, before the innumerable multitude of angels were gathered together, Or ever the heights of the air were lifted up, before the measures of the firmament were named, or ever the chimneys in Sion were hot” … “before they were sealed that have gathered faith for a treasure.”

“Then did I consider these things, and they all were made through me alone, and through none other: by me also they shall be ended, and by none other.” The Most High made all of that, so we can't question that kind of understanding. We are not on the level to question how the Lord did things. Nobody did this but him, and by him alone it shall be ended.

So he sends Christ when he is ready to send Christ. We don't know the day or the hour, but we know we are in the season, and the enemies of the Lord include some of our own people siding with the oppressors by agreeing to be in sin and destroying their own people. That is not the agencies; that is negroes being wicked as hell, and negro is a mind state across all twelve tribes that was never supposed to be you. Knowing these things are coming, we need to get our minds and our spirits right.

precepts.label: Isaiah 40:13-17
precepts.why:
God's vantage point is far beyond the vantage point we think we have. People try to tell the Lord what to do: you can't love Jacob, you can't hate Esau, you can't forgive this one. So the Lord clears the deck and lets everybody know where he stands, and everybody else needs to shut the hell up.

“Who hath directed the Spirit of the Lord, or being his counsellor hath taught him?” Nobody. These are questions for us who are trying to push him. The dumb Christian talks about the way the Lord should be; shut up. “With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?” Who taught God knowledge? Nobody. God is the knowledge; how are you going to teach him?

Having asked questions we can't answer, he proclaims what it is: “Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket.” You walk with a pail of water and one drop falls out; you won't even notice it. All the nations put together are that one drop. They “are counted as the small dust of the balance”: not big dust, small dust on the scales, weighing nothing. “He taketh up the isles as a very little thing”: the Polynesian and Hawaiian islands, very little, nothing.

“And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.” If they burnt up all the meat in Lebanon, it would not be sufficient for him to accept the Arabs, Ishmael, as his people. Only the Israelites are his people; that is why the first verse of the chapter says, comfort ye my people.

“All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.” Less than nothing is spit, a bowel movement. That is how the nations are counted to God, while to us he says comfort ye my people. That is the difference, and nobody can say anything against it. 2 Esdras 6:55-56 parallels it and calls them spittle: Ezra was quoting Isaiah. The supreme power has it set up the way he wants it set up.

thread.label: Jeremiah 17:9-10
thread.text: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?

precepts.label: Proverbs 16:2
precepts.why:
“The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?” The heart is the mind, and nothing is more deceitful than the mind. Christ showed what comes out of it: “For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders, Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.”

Yet Solomon says, “All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes”. Every one of us thinks we are righteous. Ask them: me? I ain't do nothing. Covetous spirit? Hatred? Oh, no. Judas would have said the same. All our ways are clean in our own eyes.

“but the Lord weigheth the spirits.” The Lord sees everything, and you cannot hide from the Most High. You can fool the deacon, you can fool the bishop and the leadership, but the Most High sees you, and you are not fooling yourself either. You know where you were last night, why you never called the brother back, and why you told her to hush before you answered the phone.

That is Jeremiah 17:10: “I the Lord search the heart, I try the reins”. Only God can search the mind, and he weighs what is really in it, not what we show each other. Read on: “Commit thy works unto the Lord, and thy thoughts shall be established.”

precepts.label: Romans 8:27
precepts.why:
“I the Lord search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.” Most of us only see each other on the Sabbath, and when we come around each other we are on our best behaviour. Six days a week, Sunday to Friday, we do not know where you are or what you are doing. So what are you doing when you are not here? The sister in Georgia bowed, said shalom and happy Sabbath for ten years while carrying on with the Uber Eats driver. She thought she was fooling us, and surely thought she was fooling the Most High. You cannot fool the Most High.

Paul says the same: “And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit”. The one who searches the heart is searching the mind. And that verse tells you there are two: the spiritual and the physical man. There is a war, the spirit against the flesh, wicked against righteous, darkness against light.

That war will never be over until Christ comes back or you die in this. Some want it to be over and ask why there is so much evil in their head. Maybe because you are not reading enough. Brothers who do not know the scriptures will be the ones to betray you, because when they come to him he will fall. Ask yourself when the brother you talk to during the week last talked scripture with you. The Lord searching the heart gives every man according to his ways: not the deacon's way or the bishop's way, but yours. You are your own biggest enemy.

precepts.label: Jeremiah 25:15
precepts.why:
The Lord told Jeremiah, “Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.” All the nations are made to drink of that cup.

Then Jeremiah 51:7 tells you whose hand the cup is in: “Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, that made all the earth drunken”. Babylon is America. The Babylon of these days is not just ancient Babylon; it is America. The same cup the Lord told Jeremiah to pour on all the nations is in Babylon's hand, and the Lord is using America, its administration, as his sword to bring judgment on the earth. Whoever sits in office, the next one will take over and it goes on.

That golden cup goes into oppression: falsehood, lies, oppression. “the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.” What is in the cup is not just riches but America's wrath and ill dealing, like going into Venezuela, taking its president, and then having millions of barrels of oil, about four billion dollars' worth, sent to America as tribute. That is why the nations all over the world are becoming angry with America.

precepts.label: Revelation 16:12
precepts.why:
“And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.” Prepared for what? Prepared for war.

Read on: “And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.” The dragon is the white man. These three are their politics, their religion and their economics, unclean things going out of the mouth of Edom.

“For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them”. Why are these things gathering the nations? Because they are oppression: America destroying people's economic systems, making war with nations, supporting the Israelis in the land over there, dropping bombs on Iran, going into Venezuela and kidnapping a standing president and calling him a drug dealer, saying it will take Greenland. These policies are the unclean things getting everybody around the world mad.

That is the madness of Jeremiah 51:7. The nations have drunk of Babylon's golden cup, and they are being gathered to battle because of what America has poured out on the earth.

“I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people”. Right now it can be routine: you go to work every day, stop in the donut store for a donut and your coffee, eat the donut, and then remember, damn, it's the days of unleavened bread, how could I forget? But the Lord God says his laws will be in our minds. We are not going to forget, and we will do them and serve him. That is the new covenant. We are in the beginning of it now, but once Christ returns it will be fully established in the wilderness.

“And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.” All of us will know the Lord, from the least amongst us to the greatest. You won't have to go and teach anybody, because the Lord is going to teach us. Every custom and thought we learned in America has to go, and he will show us even the parts we are missing now, like the sun and the moon working together for the times and seasons, wisdom destroyed from amongst us through slavery.

So being brought into the bond of the covenant is us being purged in the wilderness again. As he pleaded with our fathers and got rid of the leaven from amongst them, he will “purge out from among you the rebels, and them that transgress against me”: those that break God's laws, those with leaven in them. It is the wine cup of Jeremiah 25:15: “Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.” And Jeremiah 51:7 shows whose hand that cup is in: “Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.” Babylon is not just ancient Babylon; it is America. What is in that cup is falsehood, lies, oppression and ill dealing, and that is why the nations are becoming angry with America.

So under that oppressing sword, many fall, and the cry goes up: “let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity”. This is why Daniel 4:17 matters now: the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, he has raised up the wicked as his sword over this side of the world where Israel is, and he is using it to bring judgment on the earth.

The Constitution was written when you was a slave, and it counted you three-fifths of a man.

“Set him not by thee, lest, when he hath overthrown thee, he stand up in thy place”: do not make marriages with him and his woman. It happened in South Africa and in South American countries. thread.label: Habakkuk 2:1-4
thread.text: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.

precepts.label: Isaiah 46:8-11
precepts.why:
Habakkuk stood on his tower demanding answers: how long are we going to be in this captivity? The Lord answered, “the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come”. Now that we know what time we are in, Isaiah says, “Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.”

Be men and use your mind. God gave the sons of God a mind to envision greatness, to see things in the mind before the hands build them. He gave you that vantage point so you can set up a congregation and make sure evil does not come among the brothers and sisters. O ye transgressors: change.

“I am God, and there is none like me, Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done”. God declared the end before he said, Let there be light. Everything falls in the path he wants it to fall. He knew from ancient times that the fourth bird from the mother hen would fly over Wyoming on March 7th, 2028. You say that bird is insignificant; he says, I need that bird to do that because it is connected to something else you don't know about. That is his vantage point.

“Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country”. While he causes that bird to come from the east, he calls another man to execute his judgment. “I have purposed it, I will also do it.” A sparrow shall not fall to the ground unless the Most High causes it. Everything is under his auspices; he knows why he holds the armies back so the earth is not destroyed. You and I are not on that level, and we try to move God while we will not keep the commandments. The only thing we need to do is obey what he said.

That is why the vision will not lie. We cannot reason out why he calls that insignificant raven, but in God's overall plan it is necessary, and the end he declared from the beginning will surely come.

precepts.label: Isaiah 55:7-11
precepts.why:
Habakkuk was told, “the just shall live by his faith”, by the words of the book of our fathers. Isaiah shows what that faith requires of us: “Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the Lord, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.”

Those of us in wickedness must forsake it, and forsake the unrighteous thoughts of lasciviousness, lust, adultery and fornication. Get that thing out of your mind. He will pardon us if we are sincere, not pretending while on the back end doing evil and thinking nobody sees. The Lord understands the heartbeat of a raven, how many times a bird's heart will beat its whole life, and you think he don't see your black ass? You are playing with death.

“For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the Lord. For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways”. Looking down from heaven on the whole planet, he sees everything we cannot. Our only vantage point is our immediate circumference, and we cannot take that and tell the Lord what to do.

It works the same in the congregation. A manager of a department sees his space; the leadership over all the departments sees the interactions between them, and why something is happening here and not there. Leaders are in front to protect the flock because they see the danger you do not see. The man on the tower sees it coming and sounds the trumpet with a certain sound, so the people know what to prepare for.

“So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please”. As the rain waters the earth and does not return void, everything the Lord sends has a purpose. So when leadership says, brother, leave the sister alone, or sister, leave the brother alone, there is a vantage point you do not see, and if you will not hear it, it gets revealed in judgment after you done laid with the dude. Follow the steps, betrothal and the whole nine, and the council can bless the wedding and counsel the trouble in the flesh. Say to hell with all of it, and you are saying you have nothing to do with us.

precepts.label: 1 Peter 5:2
precepts.why:
Habakkuk said, “I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower”. The watchman on the tower sees what the people below cannot. Peter gives the elders that charge: “Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof”.

Listen to the wording: taking the oversight. The leaders stand at a vantage point the flock cannot see. From the experience and the level they have reached over their years in the truth, they see what younger men and younger women do not, and God gave them revelation through the scriptures to see how to guide you. If we believe there is a God, and that Christ is the brain of this whole operation, then we are supposed to trust the men he set up.

But a lot of brothers and sisters in the congregation get horny and antsy and will not follow the counsel. What you put into your vessel determines what comes out, and a lot of times we don't even realize we are being controlled. You were made in a factory called America, and those are not your words. precepts.label: Job 31:1

That is the three-second rule. The eyes are input. If you let yourself look at something for more than three seconds, it goes into your working memory, your short-term memory; keep looking at it and you are programming yourself into long-term memory. Turn away within three seconds and it doesn't have time to work within your memory. That is why TikTok gives you three seconds to capture somebody's attention, and why Netflix keeps it moving: once they have your attention through your eyes, they have you. Our eyes are the portal to take control over your vessel.

The algorithm is a reflection of you. Your searches and your scrolls tell who you are, what makes you sad, what makes you mad, what music you play when you're angry. So when you say the algorithm got you, it's not them getting you. It's you, manifested on a screen. The devil don't make you do anything you don't want to do.

David said the same: “I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes.” Train your eyes. If a show is full of action but something enticing comes on that goes against your values and your struggles, turn it off, click by. If you hear gossip or something negative, leave the conversation, because three seconds of listening will taint you, and three seconds of something negatively influencing you will control you.

precepts.label: Sirach 18:30-31
precepts.why:
“Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats”: food is for nourishment. “Now the body is not for fornication, but for the Lord”. Paul moves from food to fornication because the two are correlated: both deal with self-control over your vessel, which was created as a vessel of righteousness to be used for the master's work.

Sirach says: “Go not after thy lusts, but refrain thyself from thine appetites.” You might think it is only talking about sex, but your appetite can be anything you overindulge in: food, sex, working out, TV and entertainment, sports, scrolling. We focus on food and sex because they are one and the same, and if we get control over those two we can get control of anything in our life and reprogram our vessel to do what the Lord commands.

There are wants and there are needs. You need sex, in marriage; when you do not need, study, pray, fast. You are hungry, you eat and nourish your body, then you choose the foods that give you the energy to think, function and be productive in this work. That is what food is for.

“If thou givest thy soul the desires that please her, she will make thee a laughingstock to thine enemies that malign thee.” You become a laughingstock. There are videos saying, I can't listen to a fat prophet. A brother is powerful in the street, cutting people up, bad to the bone, and people say, I can't listen to you because you don't even listen to you. That is why they say bring back fat-shaming: you are operating outside the realm of discipline.

Satan tells you that you are hungry; Satan tells you to eat that McDonald's, that Burger King, that candy. These things are pushed on us to keep us sickly so we cannot do the work, sick every Sabbath. Feed the body the vitamins, fiber and nutrients it needs, so you possess your vessel and it serves the Lord.

precepts.label: 1 John 2:15-16

“All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of any.” John shows the power we must not come under: “Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.”

The world here is predominantly America. America is the kingdom of sin, specifically designed and created against us, in complete opposition to us, to cater to and test the flesh. It is either to make you or break you, to forge you or destroy you. Only the strong, spiritually, mentally and physically, are going to survive this kingdom.

Do not love the things catered to us in entertainment, catered to us when we are bored and idle. Scrolling is idle; that is love of the world. Porn is love of the world. Instagram models are love of the world. Clubbing is love of the world.

“For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.” Satan was given power over this world, and he is going to try to get you to operate outside of your purpose. What looks good to the eyes and caters to the appetite is not always good; look past the outside to the ingredients. The body is not for any of that; it is for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

“Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves”. Every brother and sister must examine themselves, and nobody can prove you but you. Ask yourself what you are doing that keeps you from growing in the spirit of Christ, and what you need help with. Do not wait until you hit rock bottom. The faith is the scriptures, and you must constantly examine yourself to see that you are still in it, because Satan can bind us while we still think we are in the truth, hardly reading, hardly studying, hardly watching class.

Knowing yourself means knowing your triggers and your weak point. If you are covetous, you should not have a job dealing with money. If you are lustful, you should not be watching certain videos or listening to R&B heavy. Music, movies and social media will lead you to porn. My lust and your lust might be different, but if I know myself, I know mine. So when the thought comes you say, self, we ain't going to do that today, turn it off and meditate on the scriptures. If you do not examine yourself, you are reprobate, and you let Satan use your body to do whatever he wants.

Why does it matter so much? “Giving no offence in any thing, that the ministry be not blamed”. Satan wants us to shame the ministry, and he makes us believe it is just a little thing. But people want to prove us wrong. They are ready to pick at any little thing: see what leadership is doing, see what the brothers and sisters are doing. Satan sets people inside the congregations for this, ready to say, I'm offended, I'm leaving.

Yet offences are everywhere. Solomon offended, and the whole of Israel was not destroyed; Israel still went on. One man's sin does not destroy everything, which is why we pray and fast for our leadership to stay on course. So take every little thing as a big thing, keep examining yourself, and do not go back to sin, so that the ministry is not blamed.

precepts.label: 2 Timothy 2:19
precepts.why:
“Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves.” No one can examine you; you examine yourself. “Know ye not your own selves”: you know the evil you are fighting inside, the thoughts you have, the things you do in secret thinking no one sees you. Look in the mirror and ask, self, am I real? Some say they are in the faith, but in secret they are in the midst of all type of evil, giving in again and again to lasciviousness and fornication. If you cannot examine yourself, you are reprobate. Paul prayed “that ye do no evil”, and the same goes for brothers and sisters today.

Then Timothy: “Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his.” God knows who belongs to him. “And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.” Every one of us that calls upon the name of the Lord must depart from iniquity. You brothers should not be adulterers, dealing with prostitutes, dealing with hoes. You sisters should not be sleeping around. No one should be doing schemes and credit card fraud.

“But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.” There are not just vessels of gold here in IUIC. The dishonourable one is faking it in here, here for his own reasons and ulterior motives. So ask yourself: am I real or am I fake? Which vessel are you? Only you alone know, and you have to choose which one you want to be.

Every one of us has demons and thorns we are fighting, so do not act perfect here while Satan has you in a chokehold during the week. We understand you are burning after years of doing it on the regular and now going cold turkey, but come talk to the brothers, go talk to the sisters, and ask for help. Do not let your sins weigh you down and destroy you, because God will judge.

precepts.label: Romans 13:14
precepts.why:
“Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.” What does it mean to walk in the Spirit? It does not mean moonwalking or walking on the air. Romans explains it: “But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ”, that is, the commandments and your faith, “and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.” To make provision for the flesh is not walking in the Spirit.

To make provision is to make a way for you to fulfil that lust, leaving doors open for the sin. Why are you on the phone with your ex? You are going to end up banging her. If you are struggling, delete Instagram and delete certain things; put controls on your phone so you cannot go on certain things. People say, I made a mistake, I slipped and fell, I don't know what happened. So you were walking and just slipped and fell on the dude? There was planning. You were talking to him first, and you planned what day to meet up. It was already in your mind. It was a decision, not a mistake.

With porn, if it is that bad, get rid of social media. Do not say, I can handle it, I'm good. That is Satan telling you that, and leaving it open keeps fuelling the lust, because every time you go on you see a bunch of different stuff. Some of you say you repented but leave little doors open, and you fall back into that sin. Sit down and talk to yourself: I am dealing with this, so I need to set things up so I do not fall into it.

Because “the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh”. It is a war: you want to stop, you stop for a week or two, and it comes back. The works of the flesh are “Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness”, all sexual sins. That discipline applies in marriage too: forty or eighty days after your wife gives birth, and her seven days. Satan does not come when you are dealing with your woman; he comes when you are not getting any. Those are the days to fast more and occupy yourself with the Lord. As men we cannot let pleasure control us.

precepts.label: Joshua 1:8
precepts.why:
“he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.” When you sow yourself into the scriptures, the Lord is going to give you blessings: he will show you favor, have mercy on you, and give you abundance. That is Joshua 1:8: “This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night.”

We should meditate on the scriptures day and night, “that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous, and then thou shalt have good success.” Meditating and doing is the sowing.

When we do that, the Lord makes our way prosperous. He gives us the abundance we desire, spiritually, emotionally, all the increases we desire, when we put our mind on the Lord. That is reaping of the Spirit.

precepts.label: Romans 6:23
precepts.why:
“whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.” What you put in, you are going to reap. When you put in the sin, the consequences are going to happen, period. Paul says it plainly: “For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.”

Sin is death. That is the corruption reaped by the one who sows to his flesh: sow that sin to your flesh and you will be judged by it. And the gift of God, eternal life through Christ, is the “life everlasting” reaped by the one who sows to the Spirit.

What you put in, you are going to receive as a reward. Wages for sin, a gift for the one who sows to the Spirit. God is not mocked.

precepts.label: Deuteronomy 30:19
precepts.why:
The Lord set both harvests before Israel from the beginning: “I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live.”

What you put in, you are going to get; you are going to receive a reward. Life and blessing for the one who sows to the Spirit, death and cursing for the one who sows to his flesh. Heaven and earth are called as witnesses, so no one can say he was not told. God is not mocked.

And the choice reaches past you: choose life “that both thou and thy seed may live.” What a man sows, his children reap with him.

precepts.label: Joshua 24:15
precepts.why:
“And if it seem evil unto you to serve the Lord, choose you this day whom ye will serve.” You cannot serve two masters. You can't serve the flesh and serve God at the same time. You have to choose; ain't no in between.

That is why he said he would rather you be cold or hot. If you are lukewarm, battling that middle ground and playing games, he will spew you out of his mouth. Sowing to the flesh and sowing to the Spirit cannot be done at once.

“whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land ye dwell: but as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord.” Choose the Lord, sow to the Spirit, and of the Spirit reap life everlasting.

precepts.label: Wisdom of Solomon 1:5
precepts.why:
Paul speaks of those “Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.” When we overindulge excessively, outside the guidelines God gave us, we start to operate outside the realm of God, outside the realm of discipline, and into the realm of Satan. That is why God gave us a law.

“For the holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit, and remove from thoughts that are without understanding.” The Bible says discipline is a holy spirit. There is a cap and a limit. The man who cannot stop eating is worshipping himself, because God says to eat in moderation and to eat what nourishes; do not eat just to eat. Christ said his meat was to do the will of the Father, but people followed him just for the food, because their god was the belly.

Discipline has to be practiced. People wonder why they cannot obtain discipline: it is because they do not have the Holy Spirit. There is a level of the Holy Spirit given to you because you know your nationality, but there are levels to accessing it and gaining power in it. The disciples reached the level where they worked miracles.

Full access to the Holy Spirit comes through disciplining our food intake and our sex outtake. Food and sex are closely related in the body: one is for procreation of life, the other for nourishing that life. Those two are our stumbling blocks, the two things that keep us from progressing and moving forward.

precepts.label: Sirach 33:29
precepts.why:
“Be not excessive toward any; and without discretion do nothing.” Do not be excessive toward anything. You might say, but I am hungry. Then ask yourself why you are eating. Is it for nourishment, the proper nutrients? Or because it looks good, smells good, tastes good, because you like the sound of it? Are outside things programming you, catering to the lust of the flesh through your eyes and your ears? Did you eat just five minutes ago and now you have to get a snack?

Some are excessive even with sex, a nymphomaniac, wanting sex all the time. Sex was created for procreation; outside of that it becomes pleasure. How much pleasure until the body is completely fulfilled? There is never an end to it. The same with weed: what high are you looking for, when you always come down? There is no fulfillment in smoking weed, drinking alcohol, the excess of sex, or overeating.

That is why the scriptures speak of the holy spirit of discipline. The only fulfillment is in disciplining your spirit and keeping God’s commandments. Once you go outside the realm of discipline, you are catering to the realm of Satan, and you open yourself to be a target and to be controlled at any level. That is the mind of those who “mind earthly things” in Philippians 3.

precepts.label: Romans 16:18
precepts.why:
“For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly.” This is the same people Paul wept over in Philippians 3, “whose God is their belly”: the wicked of our people. The scribes and Pharisees could not resist the wisdom of Christ or deny his miracles, but they loved the position Rome placed them in, the accolades, the greetings in the marketplace, and what comes with authority: food and sex. They crept into women’s houses as in Susanna; Eli’s sons exploited the women at the temple, because position and status bring money, power and respect.

They serve their own fleshly pleasures and lusts: let me get over on this person, let me defraud him, let me steal, so I can fill my own belly. Biggie said he was only selling crack to feed his family. He did not serve the Lord Jesus Christ; his own stomach became his god.

Your vessel is an indicator of who you serve. By the way you look, carry yourself, your conduct, your speech and your character, we can tell who your master is. People are going to get mad, but if you are grotesquely overweight, outside the realm of a natural diet, then you are your own god. You say you do not celebrate birthdays, the highest satanic celebration of oneself, yet if you cannot control your food intake, your god is your belly, and that is you.

The good thing is you can control it and do something about it, just like you control whether you celebrate birthdays. God looks at things differently than we do, so we have to reframe our mindset into the mind of Christ and the Father.

If he has to do it all before you reciprocate anything, something's wrong, and you might be the reason your marriage is the way it is.

precepts.label: 1 Timothy 6:12
precepts.why:
“Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our profession.” What is our profession? We are prophets, and a prophet’s profession is to teach. All of us are supposed to be teachers. Timothy gives the charge: “Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.”

You cannot get that eternal life if you do not hold on to your profession. How are you going to fight the good fight of faith if you are not holding on to it? Your profession is to go out there and wake up our people. Your profession is to put in work, because faith without works is dead. Your first work is supposed to be in this truth, not your job. The minute we say profession, some think we mean I’m a nurse, I’m a doctor. No.

What good is it for a prophet to do nothing with it? Some of you never travel, never leave the state of Georgia, yet you say I’m a prophet. All Israel is not in Georgia; Israel is scattered to the four corners of the earth. How many of you prophets have a valid passport? Brothers have had passports since they were three. If you don’t have one, you should be ashamed. Get a passport; Donald Trump is going to force you to get one too. We have much work to do.

And “all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.” God will bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good or evil. So hold fast the profession, fight the fight, and lay hold on eternal life with a high priest who was “in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.”

precepts.label: Proverbs 29:1
precepts.why:
Hebrews warns “lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you”. Where does that root come from? Proverbs answers: “He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck”. He that is often corrected hardens his neck, meaning his mind. You can't tell that brother nothing: I'm a man, you a man, I do what I want. Well, do what you want and burn by yourself.

That is the mindset of a lot of our brothers and sisters. They never took the scripture serious. Leadership corrects them, corrects them, corrects them, to the point where the correction is null and void, because they are not going to apply anything. After a while the Lord says, this spirit is rebellious as hell; he always hardens his mind and doesn't give a damn what you're saying.

You end up hardening your heart from always having correction done to you, until at the end of the day bitterness is formed, and then you're out the door with your wife and your children.

So the question for every brother and sister: are you one of the many that shall be offended when correction comes, when the men are told to get their homes in order and the women to be that pillar of rest and not stress? Or will you get in check with the Lord? The bitterness of Hebrews 12 grows out of a neck hardened against reproof.

precepts.label: Psalms 109:6-9
precepts.why:
Hebrews says “Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau”. Paul is comparing the wicked of our people to Esau, who was wicked and estranged from the womb and went to the Canaanitish women when he wanted to get married. The bitter among us become compared to Edom, and Satan becomes their daddy. Psalms shows it: “Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.” That wicked man is Satan, the daddy of Esau and of the wicked of our people.

“When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.” Why does his prayer become sin? Because Christ said if you have an ought with your brother, go to him; leave your gift at the altar. You can't come to the Lord while the matter between you and your brother and your sister is not dealt with right. In 2018 there were extortioners speaking against leadership. You are not supposed to rise up against the hoary head; you are supposed to honor, and not revile the gods, your leaders. There was a lot of disrespect and dishonor.

“Let his days be few; and let another take his office. Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.” That is what happens when Satan becomes your daddy. Repent.

So the profane spirit of Hebrews 12, the bitter brother or sister who turns on leadership, carries this lot. We are trying to encourage our people not to be worldly, not to keep the customs of Edom and the I-do-me, but to come back home to your people.
